messages:
sree: heads up — seeing DNS failures for internal svc.* across eu-west and apac-edge since ~09:05 UTC. Pods can't resolve leader.my-svc.cluster.local -> timeouts.

alex: timeline? any config changes deployed?

sree: we rotated NAT pools and rolled stub-proxy image 09:00 (k8s DaemonSet). infra-bot shows probe failures right after.

infra-bot: [alert] stub-proxy/daemonset rolling update started by infra-cd (deployment/daemonset stub-proxy: v1.3.2 -> v1.3.3)

mika: can you paste /etc/resolv.conf from an affected node?

sree: paste:
```
search cluster.local svc.cluster.local
nameserver 169.254.20.10
options ndots:5 timeout:2 attempts:1
```

alex: dig against the nameserver shows intermittent SERVFAIL and DNSSEC failures — but these records are internal, no DNSSEC. example:
```
; <<>> DiG 9.16 <<>> +short leader.my-svc.cluster.local @169.254.20.10
; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: SERVFAIL, id: 12345
; flags: qr rd ra; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 0, AUTHORITY: 0, ADDITIONAL: 0
```

mika: hmm. Could be split-view TTL mismatch + negative caching from upstream. If stub-proxy is flapping during NAT rotation, recursive forwarders could serve NX/TLC responses with long TTL.

jamie: also saw resolver rotation logs: the edge stub was bouncing between forwarders on 10.0.3.5/10.0.3.6 — conntrack exhaustion earlier. Maybe some queries hit a broken forwarder.

sree: repro steps: curl from pod -> get NX for leader, but `resolvectl query leader.my-svc.cluster.local` on node returns OK sometimes.

alex: quick mitigation: pin nameserver in resolv.conf to working forwarder via ConfigMap mount (temp) and flush caches.

mika: commands I ran to flush caches:
```
resolvectl flush-caches || systemd-resolve --flush-caches
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/stub-proxy -n kube-system
```

sree: applied pin + flushed on 3 nodes, resolution recovered for ~10min but then some pods back to failing.

jamie: added tcp fallback to dnsmasq in front of stub-proxy, will push canary for eu-west.

alex: long term we need: consistent split-horizon TTLs, lower negative-caching for internal zones, and make stub-proxy health-check prefer UDP/TCP fallback.

mika: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/834 (dns: lower NX cache for internal zones + healthcheck tweaks)

sree: monitoring: alerting rule temp-svc-dns-errors bumped; will keep watch. thanks all :thumbsup:

infra-bot: [deploy] canary dnsmasq eu-west started (pods:2)

jamie: canary looks stable for 12m, rollback plan ready.

sree: will follow up in incident postmortem — suspect interaction between NAT rotation, stub-proxy rolling update, and split-horizon cache TTLs.

alex: cheers. small note: maybe drop ndots to 2 for pods that do short names.

mika: filed follow-up ticket: INFRA-1972

sree: closing the thread, moving to postmortems channel.
